# Head-to-Head — vs. Python Heuristics — Tables

The tables of the [Python-heuristics comparison](tier2.md) list, one per size, every tool in one ordering by quality, the shorter time first on a tie:

- quality is minimum separation on U1;
- a `max-div` row is one series at one quoted budget: the median over seeds of its quality and of its measured time;
- an entrant row is the mean over seeds of its quality and time.

Below each table, the overtake budget is the smallest budget of a series at which `max-div`'s median reaches the best one-shot result.
